rules: Replay ops on a fresh WorkshopController (shared gear_rules, shop, starter_gears). steps[0] is the state after construction; steps[i] after ops[i-1]. held[i] is true while offer slot i is held. A checkpoint step also holds the saved WorkshopController JSON (ledger times use the fixed clock 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z). Board entries: id|definition|tier|x,y|lane|interval, sorted by row then column.
